hero.headline: Kinderbetreuung zu Hause — verlässlich, geprüft, einfach.
hero.description: KinderStars vermittelt Familien in ganz Deutschland geprüfte Betreuungspersonen — Babysitter, Kinderfrauen, Nannies und (wo anerkannt) Kindertagespflegepersonen. Die Betreuung findet bei Ihnen zu Hause statt.
hero.privacyNote: Datenschutz zuerst: Profile zeigen die PLZ-Region (z. B. 10115), keine vollständige Adresse. Buchungen und Zahlungen laufen über KinderStars.

parents.heading: Kinderbetreuung, die zu Ihrer Familie passt
parents.description: Nennen Sie uns das Alter Ihres Kindes, gewünschte Tage und Uhrzeiten sowie Ihre PLZ — wir schlagen eine passende Betreuungsperson vor und unterstützen bei Buchung, Zahlung und Rechnung.
parents.nationwideDesc: Wir verbinden Sie mit Betreuungspersonen in ganz Deutschland, die unser Prüf- und Onboarding-Verfahren durchlaufen haben.
parents.standardsDesc: Jede Betreuungsperson folgt unserem Qualitätsrahmen für Kinderschutz, Erste Hilfe und altersgerechte Betreuung.
parents.supportDesc: KinderStars bleibt Ihre Anlaufstelle für Fragen, Änderungen oder Anliegen — vor, während und nach der Vermittlung.
parents.paymentDesc: Suchen und Anfragen sind kostenlos. Betreuungskosten können privat, vom Arbeitgeber, der Hochschule, dem Jobcenter oder Jugendamt getragen werden — je nach Berechtigung.

howItWorks.heading: So funktioniert's
howItWorks.description: Verlässliche Kinderbetreuung soll nicht stressig sein. In drei klaren Schritten zum Match.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Durchsuchen Sie unser Verzeichnis nach PLZ, Altersgruppe, benötigten Tagen und Verifikationsstatus.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Senden Sie Ihre Anforderungen über KinderStars. Wir moderieren die Kommunikation und schützen Ihre Daten.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Wir stellen eine passende Betreuungsperson vor, begleiten das Onboarding und bleiben für Sie erreichbar.

whyUs.heading: Aufgebaut auf Vertrauen und Qualität
whyUs.description: Wir sind mehr als ein Verzeichnis. KinderStars begleitet Betreuungspersonen aktiv und gibt Eltern die Sicherheit gleichbleibender Standards.
whyUs.safeguardingDesc: Jede Betreuungsperson durchläuft Prüfungen wie erweitertes Führungszeugnis, Erste Hilfe am Kind und eine Kinderschutzschulung, bevor sie im Verzeichnis erscheint.
whyUs.qualityDesc: KinderStars steht für hohe Standards in Qualität, Compliance und Kindeswohl.
whyUs.privacyDesc: Profile zeigen nur PLZ-Regionen — keine vollständigen Adressen. Alle Anfragen laufen über KinderStars, um Familien und Betreuungspersonen zu schützen.
whyUs.multilingualDesc: Unsere Betreuungspersonen sprechen viele Sprachen — u. a. Deutsch, Englisch, Türkisch, Polnisch, Arabisch — passend zu den Familien, die wir betreuen.
whyUs.ongoingSupportDesc: Nach der Vermittlung verschwinden wir nicht. Wir sichern die Qualität, geben Orientierung und sind Ansprechpartner bei Anliegen.
whyUs.fundingDesc: Suchen und Anfragen sind kostenlos. Kosten können privat, über Arbeitgeber, Hochschule, Jobcenter oder Jugendamt gedeckt werden — Förderung ist von Berechtigung und Vorabgenehmigung abhängig.

payment.heading: Wege zur Finanzierung
payment.description: Suchen und Anfragen sind kostenlos. Betreuung ist kostenpflichtig — viele Familien reduzieren die Kosten durch Förderung oder steuerliche Absetzbarkeit.
payment.govDesc: Je nach Bundesland kann eine öffentlich geförderte Kindertagespflege über das Jugendamt (§23 SGB VIII) infrage kommen. Berechtigung, Stundenkontingent und Sätze entscheidet die zuständige Behörde — Förderung ist von Berechtigung, örtlichen Regelungen und vorheriger Genehmigung abhängig.
payment.studentDesc: Vollzeitstudierende können bei ihrem Studierendenwerk oder dem Familienfonds ihrer Hochschule Unterstützung für Kinderbetreuungskosten beantragen. Verfügbarkeit und Höhe variieren.
payment.employerDesc: Arbeitgeber können sich steuerfrei an Betreuungskosten für nicht schulpflichtige Kinder beteiligen (§3 Nr. 33 EStG). Zudem können seit 2025 bis zu 80% der anerkannten Betreuungskosten — max. 4.800 € pro Kind und Jahr — in der Einkommensteuererklärung geltend gemacht werden, sofern die Zahlungen ordnungsgemäß dokumentiert sind.
payment.selfPayDesc: Zahlen Sie die Betreuungsperson direkt über die Plattform. Sätze variieren nach Region, Stunden und Alter des Kindes. KinderStars zeigt Ihnen übliche Preisrahmen.
payment.notSure: Nicht sicher, was für Sie in Frage kommt?
payment.notSureDesc: Kontaktieren Sie uns — wir helfen bei der Einordnung, bevor Sie sich festlegen.

childminders.heading: Bauen Sie Ihre Betreuungslaufbahn mit KinderStars aus
childminders.description: Ob neu qualifiziert oder erfahren — bei KinderStars erhalten Sie Sichtbarkeit, Schulungen und einen stetigen Strom von Anfragen. Der Basis-Zugang ist kostenlos.
childminders.visibilityDesc: Lassen Sie sich im Verzeichnis listen, damit Familien in Ihrer Region Sie über KinderStars finden und anfragen können.
childminders.trainingDesc: Zugang zu Kinderschutz-Auffrischungen, Erste Hilfe am Kind und weiterführenden Fortbildungen der KinderStars Academy.
childminders.complianceDesc: Wir begleiten Sie bei Führungszeugnis, ggf. Pflegeerlaubnis (§43 SGB VIII), Steuer- und Sozialversicherungsstatus.
childminders.mentoringDesc: 1:1-Unterstützung durch unser Team bei Richtlinien, Elternkontakt und guter Praxis — wann immer Sie es brauchen.

testimonials.heading: What families & childminders say
testimonials.description: Real feedback from the parents and childminders we work with every day.
testimonials.quote1: KinderStars made finding a childminder so easy. Within a week we had a wonderful match for our two-year-old — someone background-checked with great references.
testimonials.quote2: I was nervous about leaving my baby with someone new, but the KinderStars team were reassuring every step of the way. They even followed up after the first week.
testimonials.quote3: As a childminder, joining KinderStars gave me visibility I never had. Their safeguarding training and ongoing support make me feel valued and professional.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Everything parents and childminders ask us — answered clearly.
faq.a1: A Childminder Agency recruits, supports, and quality-assures childminders. Parents benefit from a single trusted point of contact, and childminders receive ongoing training, safeguarding support, and visibility.
faq.q2: How much does childcare through KinderStars cost?
faq.a2: Browsing our directory and making enquiries is free. Childcare itself is a paid service — costs depend on hours, age group, and your childminder. Many families reduce costs through government-funded free hours (via the local authority), Childcare Grant for full-time students, Tax-Free Childcare, employer childcare vouchers, or direct self-payment. We're happy to help you understand your options.
faq.a3: All childminders in our directory go through extended background checks (erweitertes Führungszeugnis), first-aid for children (Erste Hilfe am Kind) certification, safeguarding training, and an onboarding process before being listed. Verified childminders have completed our full quality framework.
faq.q4: What does 'Verified' mean on a profile?
faq.a4: A 'Verified' badge means the childminder has completed KinderStars' full onboarding including Führungszeugnis, first aid, safeguarding training, and a quality review. 'Listed' childminders are in the process of completing these steps.
faq.q5: How quickly can I find a childminder?
faq.a5: Most families receive an introduction within 1–2 weeks, depending on availability in your city. Urgent requests are prioritised — just let us know your timeline when you enquire.
faq.q6: Can I choose my own childminder?
faq.a6: Absolutely. You can browse our directory, filter by location, days, age groups, and language, then enquire about anyone who looks like a good fit. We'll facilitate the introduction.
faq.a7: KinderStars is a childcare marketplace supporting families across Germany. Whether you're in Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, or elsewhere in Germany — get in touch and we'll help you find a suitable childminder in your city.
faq.q8: How do I become a KinderStars childminder?
faq.a8: If you're a registered or aspiring childminder, get in touch via our contact form or email info@kinderstars.de. We'll walk you through the onboarding process including Führungszeugnis, training, and listing on our directory.
faq.q9: Do I need to be recognised by the Jugendamt (where required) to join?
faq.a9: If you're already registered with the responsible Jugendamt, you can join as a childminder straight away. If you're not yet registered, you can join as a trainee and we'll guide you through every step.
faq.q10: What training do I need to become a childminder?
faq.a10: You'll need an enhanced extended background check (Führungszeugnis), first-aid for children (Erste Hilfe am Kind) certification, safeguarding training, and registration with your local Jugendamt. KinderStars provides a step-by-step training checklist covering the German Jugendamt process.
faq.q11: How long does it take to become a Kindertagespflegeperson?
faq.a11: Typically 3–6 months depending on your Jugendamt, but it can be faster if you already have qualifications. KinderStars supports you throughout with a personalised training plan.
faq.q12: Is there a cost to join KinderStars?
faq.a12: Joining KinderStars is free. We don't charge childminders to be listed, receive training support, or access our compliance tools.

intro.heading: Introduction
intro.body:
KinderStars (a LoungeTech GmbH service) ("we", "us", "our") is committed to protecting the privacy and personal data of everyone who uses our website and services. This policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information in accordance with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (EU GDPR / DSGVO) and the Bundesdatenschutzgesetz (BDSG).

Our registered address is Victory House, Luton, 10115 3BS. For data protection queries, email info@kinderstars.de.

whatWeCollect.heading: What personal data we collect
whatWeCollect.body:
We may collect the following personal data:

• Name and contact details (email, phone number)
• PLZ area (not full address)
• Information about your children (age, care requirements)
• Childminder professional details (qualifications, Führungszeugnis status, experience)
• Website usage data (cookies, analytics)
• Communication records (emails, enquiry form submissions)

howWeUse.heading: How we use your data
howWeUse.body:
We use your personal data to:

• Match families with suitable childminders
• Process enquiries and facilitate introductions
• Verify childminder credentials (Führungszeugnis, first aid, safeguarding)
• Improve our website and services through anonymised analytics
• Communicate important service updates
• Comply with legal and regulatory obligations

Our lawful bases for processing are: consent, contractual necessity, legitimate interests, and legal obligation.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.body:
We use essential cookies to make our website function correctly. With your consent, we may also use analytics cookies to understand how visitors use our site.

You can manage your cookie preferences at any time through the cookie banner. Essential cookies cannot be disabled as they are necessary for the site to work.

For more information, see our cookie banner which appears on your first visit.

sharing.heading: Data sharing and third parties
sharing.body:
We do not sell your personal data. We may share data with:

• Childminders in our network (limited to what's needed for matching)
• the responsible Jugendamt or authority (where legally required)
• Service providers who help us run our website (hosting, analytics)

All third parties are required to process your data securely and in accordance with our instructions and applicable data protection law.

rights.heading: Your rights under GDPR
rights.body:
Under EU GDPR / DSGVO, you have the right to:

• Access — request a copy of your personal data
• Rectification — correct inaccurate or incomplete data
• Erasure — request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
• Restrict processing — limit how we use your data
• Data portability — receive your data in a portable format
• Object — object to processing based on legitimate interests
• Withdraw consent — where processing is based on consent

To exercise any of these rights, email info@kinderstars.de. We will respond within 30 days.

retention.heading: Data retention
retention.body: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected. Enquiry data is kept for up to 24 months. Childminder records are retained for the duration of their registration plus 6 years. Analytics data is anonymised and aggregated.

children.heading: Children's data
children.body: As a childcare agency, we may process limited data about children (age, care needs). We treat this with the highest level of care and only collect what is strictly necessary for matching families with childminders. We never share children's data publicly.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. Any significant changes will be communicated on our website. We encourage you to review this page periodically.

contact.heading: Contact us
contact.body:
If you have questions about this privacy policy or wish to exercise your data rights, please contact:

KinderStars (a LoungeTech GmbH service)
Victory House, Luton, 10115 3BS
Email: info@kinderstars.de

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your responsible Landesdatenschutzaufsichtsbehörde (state data protection authority).

cookie.description: Wir nutzen essenzielle Cookies für den Betrieb der Seite. Mit Ihrer Einwilligung nutzen wir zusätzlich Analyse-Cookies. Sie können Ihre Auswahl jederzeit ändern.

intro.body:
These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the KinderStars website and services operated by KinderStars (a LoungeTech GmbH service), a company registered in Germany with its registered address at Victory House, Luton, 10115 3BS.

By accessing or using our website, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

services.heading: Our services
services.body:
KinderStars operates as a Childminder Agency. We provide:

• A directory of childminders who have been through our onboarding process
• A matching service connecting parents with suitable childminders
• Ongoing quality assurance, training, and support for childminders
• Information and guidance on childcare funding options

We do not employ childminders directly. Childminders registered with KinderStars operate as self-employed professionals.

eligibility.heading: Eligibility
eligibility.body:
Our services are available to:

• Parents and carers seeking childcare in the Germany
• Childminders who are registered or seeking registration with KinderStars

You must be at least 18 years old to use our website and services.

obligations.heading: Your obligations
obligations.body:
When using our services, you agree to:

• Provide accurate and truthful information
• Not misuse the website or attempt to gain unauthorised access
• Not copy, reproduce, or redistribute content from our website without permission
• Treat all childminders, staff, and other users with respect
• Report any safeguarding concerns immediately to KinderStars

childminderTerms.heading: Childminder-specific terms
childminderTerms.body:
Childminders registered with KinderStars agree to:

• Maintain valid extended background checks (Führungszeugnis), first-aid for children (Erste Hilfe am Kind), and safeguarding training
• Comply with our quality framework and code of conduct
• Notify KinderStars of any changes to their registration status, availability, or circumstances
• Allow KinderStars to display limited profile information (first name, last initial, PLZ area, town) on our directory
• Cooperate with quality assurance reviews and monitoring visits

fees.heading: Fees and payment
fees.body:
Browsing the KinderStars directory and submitting enquiries is free of charge.

Childcare is a paid service arranged between parents and childminders. KinderStars does not set childminder rates. Fees, payment terms, and schedules are agreed directly between the parent and childminder.

KinderStars may charge fees for certain agency services. Any applicable fees will be communicated clearly in advance.

All content on the KinderStars website — including text, graphics, logos, images, and software — is the property of KinderStars (a LoungeTech GmbH service) or its licensors and is protected by copyright and intellectual property laws.

You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works from our content without prior written consent.

liability.heading: Limitation of liability
liability.body:
KinderStars acts as an agency connecting parents with childminders. While we conduct checks and provide quality assurance, we do not guarantee the performance, conduct, or suitability of any childminder.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, KinderStars (a LoungeTech GmbH service) shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our services.

Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits our liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud, or any other liability that cannot be excluded by law.

termination.heading: Termination
termination.body:
We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to our services at any time if you breach these Terms or engage in conduct that we consider harmful to other users, childminders, or the reputation of KinderStars.

Childminders may be removed from the directory if they fail to maintain required standards, qualifications, or compliance with our quality framework.

intro.heading: Introduction
intro.body:
KinderStars (a LoungeTech GmbH service) is committed to providing a high-quality service. If you are unhappy with any aspect of our service, we want to hear about it so we can put things right and learn from your feedback.

This complaints procedure applies to parents, childminders, and anyone who uses our services.

scope.heading: What you can complain about
scope.body:
You can raise a complaint about:

• The quality of service provided by KinderStars
• The conduct or behaviour of a childminder in our network
• Communication or responsiveness from our team
• How your personal data has been handled
• Any other matter relating to our services

For safeguarding concerns about a child's welfare, please contact us immediately at info@kinderstars.de or call the relevant local authority.

informal.heading: Stage 1: Informal resolution
informal.body:
In the first instance, we encourage you to contact us directly to discuss your concern. Many issues can be resolved quickly through open communication.

You can reach us at:
• Email: info@kinderstars.de
• Address: Victory House, Luton, 10115 3BS

We aim to acknowledge your concern within 2 working days and resolve it within 10 working days.

formal.heading: Stage 2: Formal complaint
formal.body:
If you are not satisfied with the informal resolution, or if you prefer to make a formal complaint from the outset, please put your complaint in writing.

Your written complaint should include:

• Your name and contact details
• A clear description of what happened
• When it happened
• What outcome you are seeking
• Any relevant evidence or correspondence

Send your formal complaint to info@kinderstars.de with the subject line "Formal Complaint" or post it to our registered address.

investigation.heading: Stage 3: Investigation and response
investigation.body:
Upon receiving a formal complaint, we will:

• Acknowledge receipt within 3 working days
• Assign a senior member of the team to investigate
• Gather relevant information from all parties involved
• Provide a written response within 20 working days

Our response will include a summary of our findings, any actions we intend to take, and information about next steps if you remain dissatisfied.

escalation.heading: Stage 4: Escalation
escalation.body:
If you are not satisfied with our response, you may escalate your complaint to:

• Jugendamt — if your complaint relates to childcare standards or safeguarding (ofsted.gov.uk)
• The Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) — if your complaint relates to data protection (ico.org.uk)
• Your local authority's early years team — for concerns about childminder registration or conduct

We will cooperate fully with any external investigation.

recordKeeping.heading: Record keeping and learning
recordKeeping.body:
We keep confidential records of all complaints received, including the nature of the complaint, how it was handled, and the outcome. Complaint records are retained for 6 years.

We review complaints regularly to identify patterns and areas for improvement. Your feedback directly helps us improve our services.

contact.heading: Contact us
contact.body:
To raise a complaint or provide feedback, please contact:

KinderStars (a LoungeTech GmbH service)
Victory House, Luton, 10115 3BS
Email: info@kinderstars.de

We take all complaints seriously and are committed to resolving them fairly and promptly.
